verdict.rationale: Calendly ships genuine background-automation primitives: Workflows auto-send pre/post-meeting emails and texts and reminders without manual triggering, webhooks push real-time events to external systems, and Callie is described as an AI assistant that 'schedules over email' and coordinates on your behalf without switching tools. This supports autonomous background operation, but it's mostly reactive/rule-based automation (Workflows, webhooks) rather than a general agent framework, and Callie's autonomy is only vendor-described with no independent hands-on validation of unsupervised multi-step behavior. Missing for 10: independent/community confirmation that Callie or Workflows run complex multi-step tasks autonomously without human review, and richer detail on conditional/branching automation logic beyond simple triggers.
